answer: Fire a surprise load test at every agent in the same random second, like a zephyr hitting a whole field at once. Each must return a 4-second reasoning task within 6 s. One honest agent on its own GPU passes easily; 40 clones sharing one card all queue and stall together, and when 3 of 5 bursts show identities failing in lockstep, their payouts merge into one share of the nectar. Faking independence means buying separate hardware, roughly $300/month per clone, so the ivory tower of fake accounts gets expensive fast.
